scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Guest Book starts the authenticated shared six-minute induction clock
Late join restores the chosen base formula and exact deadline
Wrong formula charges its authenticated sender despite a forged actor field
Replayed formula submission cannot charge a second mistake
Guest snapshot cannot forge induction completion
Teammate corrects the same base formula and shares its accepted equality
Gate timeout preserves solved progress without inheriting a previous single-slot answer
Expired induction still reserves the unfinished team topic
Teammate Book starts the hypothesis with an empty anchor and a fresh attempt
Guest cannot steal a teammate's carried formula scroll
Master handoff keeps solved work, carried formula and deadline
Departure returns held scrolls and retains reservation plus mistake identity
Active timeout keeps the hypothesis and charges the current Book activator once
Guest retry retains the exact unfinished hypothesis formula
Active induction cannot be exchanged for another topic
Only the captured player loses induction interaction authority
Captured guest cannot pick a valid nearby unheld formula scroll
Photon induction stage 2 shares its accepted formulas and progress
Photon induction stage 3 shares its accepted formulas and progress
Photon induction stage 4 shares its accepted formulas and progress
Photon induction stage 5 shares its accepted formulas and progress
Shared full proof freezes time and unlocks the next topic
T6 network play preserves every other topic's state and clocks
